status: C1 finite identities complete; first physical implication open

nodes.name: event_KL_variational_identity
nodes.statement: For a finite conditional measure mu and event B of positive mass, the infimum of D(nu||mu) over nu(B)=1 equals -log mu(B), attained by mu conditioned on B.

nodes.name: data_processing
nodes.statement: Every measurable coarse map T satisfies D(nu||mu) >= D(T#nu||T#mu), including the binary event map.

nodes.name: multiplicity_counterexample
nodes.statement: One thousand bad states of individual penalty 5 have normalized total probability 0.8707667550426246 against one unit-weight good state.

nodes.name: normalizer_counterexample
nodes.statement: Increasing the bad-state action from 0 to 1 can increase its probability from one half to above 0.9998 if the good-state action increases to 10.

nodes.name: one_block_physical_partition_ratio
nodes.statement: For the actual nonlinear conditional Yang-Mills measure, prove a strict bad/good restricted partition-ratio gap uniform in boundary data, cutoff, volume, and positive-mass retained history.

nodes.name: defect_quasi_factorization
nodes.statement: Prove D(nu||mu) >= c_QF times the sum of declared local pushed-forward divergences, with c_QF positive and uniform in physical parameters.

nodes.name: uniform_normalized_defect_suppression
nodes.statement: Derive Z_bad(J)/Z_good(J) <= C_0 exp(-kappa |J|), and hence exponential normalized bad-event suppression, with uniform positive kappa.

nodes.name: retained_kernel_insertion
nodes.statement: Use the normalized defect bound as one bad-channel numerator estimate in the compositionally complete retained kernel.

nodes.name: continuum_mass_gap_bridge
nodes.statement: Construct the four-dimensional continuum theory and prove that a uniform physical spectral or mass gap survives OS reconstruction and continuum removal.

dependencies.role: converts an information lower bound into normalized event suppression
controls information under declared local observation maps
requires all physical multiplicities in restricted normalizers
requires a normalized bad/good comparison rather than a raw action estimate
composes local information costs across defects
supplies a normalized physical bad-channel estimate
possible input only; additional reconstruction and spectral theorems are mandatory

first_open_implication.statement: Prove a boundary-uniform physical partition-ratio estimate or defect quasi-factorization for the actual finite-volume nonlinear conditional Yang-Mills measure.

guardrails: Event-KL and data processing alone do not imply physical suppression.
Pointwise action costs do not control event probabilities without multiplicities and normalizers.
A C2 theorem must use the actual nonlinear constrained measure and uniform constants.
H5 does not currently establish OS reconstruction, continuum nontriviality, temporal clustering, or a mass gap.
